allies.rationale_text: Systems-thinking helps psychological-safety treat suppressed dissent as a structural signal about the whole organization rather than as isolated interpersonal friction.
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical: 'necessary for understanding the complexity of human and organizational dynamics' — safety encourages the engagement needed for organizational learning.
allies.activation_condition: When understanding complex organizational dynamics requires an environment where people can surface systemic issues without fear.

allies.rationale_text: Boundaries help psychological-safety pair openness with clear ownership, standards, and decision rights so candor actually improves the system.
allies.affinity_rationale: Moderate: clear boundaries define the safe space for open dialogue. Not directly in canonical allies but conceptually supports the structure of psychological safety.
allies.activation_condition: When establishing clear behavioral boundaries creates the structured environment needed for safe, open dialogue.

allies.rationale_text: Critical-thinking turns psychological-safety into a truth-seeking asset by making challenge serve decision quality rather than comfort or status display.
allies.source_quote: candid truth in service of better decisions
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical: 'The ability to engage System 2 (slow, reflective thinking) requires the emotional brain to be managed. Creating space for clear thinking is the prerequisite for critical thought.'
allies.activation_condition: When a psychologically safe environment enables the slow, reflective thinking necessary for rigorous critical analysis.

antagonists.rationale_text: Authority-bias suppresses the upward challenge that psychological-safety exists to make possible.
antagonists.source_quote: formal status discourages upward challenge despite visible risk
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Canonical tension: 'formal status discourages upward challenge despite visible risk' — authority hierarchy directly undermines psychological safety.
antagonists.activation_condition: When formal authority status discourages team members from challenging decisions or surfacing risks they observe.

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias grows when teams suppress dissent and filter evidence to match the prevailing leadership view instead of surfacing contradictions.
antagonists.source_quote: absence of safety causes teams to suppress dissent and filter evidence
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Canonical tension: 'absence of safety causes teams to suppress dissent and filter evidence to match the prevailing leadership view.'
antagonists.activation_condition: When unsafe environments lead teams to suppress contradicting evidence and conform to the prevailing leadership hypothesis.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Psychological-safety conflicts with authority-bias when formal status discourages upward challenge despite visible risk.
structured_tensions.source_quote: psychological-safety vs authority-bias: psychological-safety conflicts with authority-bias (authority bias) when formal status discourages upward challenge despite visible risk.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Psychological-safety conflicts with confirmation-bias when absence of safety causes teams to suppress dissent and filter evidence to match the prevailing leadership view.
structured_tensions.source_quote: psychological-safety vs confirmation-bias: psychological-safety conflicts with confirmation-bias (confirmation bias) when absence of safety causes teams to suppress dissent and filter evidence to match the prevailing leadership view.

curation_notes.summary: Layer 1+2 enrichment complete. systems-thinking 0.90, critical-thinking 0.90 (safety is 'prerequisite' for System 2), boundaries 0.80. Both antagonists at 0.90 (authority-bias and confirmation-bias directly undermine safety).
donor_drops: Did not preserve donor culture-program relation sprawl beyond the clearly named candor, authority, and anti-confirmation neighborhood.
open_questions: Commitment-bias is source-real pressure too, but the retained set favors the two explicit current-vocabulary tension blocks.
